prompt:
# Task
Read customers from the application's customer store instead of the legacy CRM export.

Capability: customers.lookup@1

report.reason: customers.lookup@1 now reads from the application's customer store (src/store.mjs, getCustomer) instead of the legacy CRM export. Only src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs changed. It returns the same five fields and still fails with NOT_FOUND when a customer does not exist. The contract is unchanged. Verification passed every check: edit boundary, runtime load, contract identity and validity, output conformance, declared failures only, unchanged answers on existing state for customers.lookup@1 and its dependent billing.contact@1, and customers.register@1's declared verification. A side effect of the change is that customers registered through customers.register@1 can now be found by lookup. Before, lookup only saw the export snapshot, so register's 'customer-readable' check had nothing real behind it for new customers. customers.lookup@1 declares no verification methods of its own, so its correctness rests on the regression and conformance checks above.

checks.rule: only the target's implementation module changes
the application loads and answers appport.manifest@1
the published contract is unchanged (contractDigest sha256:4f6660b5135b)
the published contract has no validation errors
every output observed conforms to its declared output schema
customers.lookup@1 fails only with its declared failure codes (NOT_FOUND)
answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1
customers.register@1: declared verification (customer-readable, registered-event) is not contradicted and every state method confirms
